projects.title: 5 Ways to Add an AI Chatbot to Your Website
projects.description: A short, practical guide breaking down five different ways a business can add chatbot functionality — from simple no-code widgets to custom AI assistants, platform bots, CRM lead-capture, and voice assistants — with real-world costs, limitations, and a decision framework for picking the right one before spending money.
